message: Running command: find /workspace/repo-vul -name "*fuzzer*" -o -name "*mvc*" | grep -v libfuzzer | head -30

message.content:
Now I understand the vulnerability. The `GETBITS` macro reads from `pu4_buf[u4_word_off]` and potentially `pu4_buf[u4_word_off]` again when `u4_bit_off` is non-zero. If the bitstream offset goes beyond the buffer size, this causes a heap-buffer-overflow read.

The crash is in `ih264d_parse_fgc` which parses SEI film grain characteristics. The issue is that the function doesn't check if there are enough bits remaining in the bitstream before reading. If the SEI payload is too short, `ih264d_get_bits_h264` will read past the end of the buffer.
